title: PlayGen2: Learning Real-Time Playable Worlds with Explicit 3D State
abstract: arXiv:2611.07867v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Building a playable world requires more than generating plausible video: it demands responsive control, persistent spatial structure, and coherent interactions with dynamic entities. Using generated frames as the sole recurrent world representation ties these requirements to view-dependent appearance synthesis, making it difficult to maintain long-term spatial and temporal consistency in generation and interaction. We present PlayGen2, a real-time interactive world model that separates learned 3D state evolution from neural rendering. PlayGen2 maintains a persistent world memory comprising static geometry represented by a volumetric occupancy grid and identity-indexed 3D states for the player and other entities. Within a fixed-size local region, its world-state model jointly learns action-conditioned entity dynamics, geometry completion, and entity discovery, committing updates to a persistent world memory. translated_title: PlayGen2：基于显式3D状态学习实时可玩世界
translated_abstract: 构建可玩的世界不仅仅是生成逼真的视频：它需要响应式的控制、持久的空间结构，以及与动态实体的连贯交互。若将生成的帧作为唯一的循环世界表示，会把上述需求与依赖视角的外观合成绑定在一起，使得在生成与交互中难以维持长期的空间和时间一致性。我们提出了PlayGen2，一种将学习到的3D状态演化与神经渲染相分离的实时交互式世界模型。PlayGen2维护一个持久的世界记忆，其中包含由体积占用栅格表示的静态几何结构，以及为玩家和其他实体建立的身份索引3D状态。在固定大小的局部区域内，其世界状态模型联合学习动作条件下的实体动力学、几何补全和实体发现，并将更新提交至持久的世界记忆。一个独立的神经渲染器（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: PlayGen2通过将显式3D世界状态的演化与神经渲染相分离，并维护由体积占用栅格和身份索引实体3D状态构成的持久世界记忆，实现了具备长期空间一致性的实时可交互可玩世界。
en_tdlr: PlayGen2 achieves real-time interactive playable worlds with long-term spatial consistency by decoupling explicit 3D state evolution from neural rendering, maintaining a persistent world memory composed of a volumetric occupancy grid and identity-indexed 3D entity states.
